data.rationale: The proposal captures the right goal (Map search with an origin and flexible dates) and the origin parameter, but it swaps the search-type parameter for a trip_type of Roundtrip, hard-codes the flexible-dates choice instead of parameterizing it, and omits the results-list step, so an automation would be roughly workable but incomplete.
